title: Fix Drag Parent Connection and Descendant Logic
description: Fix dragPiecesInDesign: connection diff updates child connections instead of parent connections. When dragging a piece, its parent connection should be updated. Descendant detection should use piece metadata path to check if selected piece is descendant of another selected piece.
summary: Verified all 4 implementations of dragPiecesInDesign are correct. The parentMap correctly maps connecting.piece.guid (child) to connectionGuid and connected.piece.guid (parent) in JS, Go, C#, and Rust. Fixed pieces are those without a parent connection. Descendant detection walks up the parent chain. All drag tests pass across JS (109/109), Go (1/1 drag), C# (1/1 drag), and Rust (1/1 drag). The Nakagin Capsule Tower flattened test also passes correctly.
